translation.name: Diosa' kiika; Génesis, Éxodo y El Nuevo Testamento

content: Chachilla yuj firu' tiyala.
Chachilla entsa tunu chutu pure' seraindu, naa pannala bain tsaren serala.
Tsenñu cha' rukula' na'mala nara deeñu' mitya, Diosa' nala
naaju kayu ura deeñu bain, mi'ke' juntsalanu supunga' yala' shinbu tire tirekila. Tsa' mitya naajulanu kandya' bain ne kakila.
Tsenñu Yavé tsandimi: Cha' ruku naa-uwanuba te' peyatyumujchi ne tsanasa tendyuve; yaa ne chachiren juñu' mitya, 120 añun chudinuke tirenu tsuyu, timi.
Tsa' mitya aa kasta chachi tusha defaalaya Diosa' nala cha' na'malanu supu deka' na dekiñaa faala. Tsaaren naa bene bain faala. Tsejtu juntsalaa kaspee tinbunu daj ruku jumuwaala.
Entsa tusha chumu chachilla mika firu' ken dechu', naa-uwanu bain firu' kiikenu pensan judeeñu,
Yavé katatu, chachillanu entsa tusha ke' chujtin jutyuunuba kikeeñuve tya', veta' pensa mantu yuj llakindyami.

Tsejtu tsandimi: In keñu chachillanu entsa tunu tsaa demanbirekenu tsuyu, tsenmin kumuinchi animaa chachi miyanuu judeeshu juntsalanu bain, naa ajkachi shilla' neimu animaalanu bain, naa pishkulanu bain demanbirekenu tsuyu, matyu ke' chujtin jutyuunuba kikeeñuve, timi.
Tsaaren Noéya Yavéchi ura' katawami.
Noé ma baaku kemi.
Entsaa Noé' kuindave. Noéya yuj ura' rukuwaami, naa-uwanuba Diosnu meenguemu. Tsa' mitya ya' chunu tinbunuya, yaa Dios naaken chusa tyamuñuba tsanguen chumuwaami.
Noé pen na miyandimuwaami: Semnu bain, Camnu bain, Jafetnu bain.
Dioschiya tu urajtu kuraa tiyaimi, chachilla urajtu tene ken chu', tituba ne kikendetsuñu.
Tsejtu kumuinchi entsa tusha chumula urajtu tene tiya deiñu' mitya, entsa tusha tsamantsa ujcha landetsuñu katatu, Dios

tsandimi Noénu: Chachillanu depirekenu tsuyu. Yala' kuipa' mityan entsa tusha tsamantsa tituba kiken ne chudenave. Tsa' mitya, yalanu depireke', kayu vera entsa tusha tiba chudenashu juntsalanu bain depirekenu tsuyu.
Tsa' mitya pillu laimu chi mi'ke' ka', baaku main ke', suku puja'tee kide, tsangue' naa juusha bain, naa avindala bain ba'dindalaya amuyachi tene kide pi vin jutyu.
Matyu iya ñunu naake aawa kide tiñuba juntsaaya kide: bare' mityaya 300 tyabulu, tsenmala bungunchiya 50 tyabulu, tsenmin katyu' mityaya 30 tyabulu.
Tsenmin pen dijki pude, tsenmin mishbui' lunu ma tyabulu faatanainshaya ma kaa juukapaa pude ke'laalaadinunu, tsenmin luluinu juukapa bain main pude ma kelusha.
Entsa tusha pi bu'ware', kumuinchi entsa tu' chumulanu depirekenu tsuyu, naa nuka bain. Tsa' mitya kumuinchi entsa tunu chudenashu juntsalaya millai peyanu detsuve.
Tsaaren ñubaa veta' veta' uraa kenu tsuyu. Tsa' mitya baakunu vi', ñu' shinbunu bain, ñu' nalanu bain, naa ñu' suyalanu bain miya' vide.
Tsenmin tusha kataamu kumuinchi animaalanu bain, main llupu ka', main supu kake', baakusha vimishtide, yai bain ñuba bulu livee inudetsu.
Tsa' mitya vee vee animaala pallu pallu baakusha ñuba vinu dejuve; naa pishkula bain, naa tusha nemu animaala bain, naa ajkachi shilla' neimu animaala bain, tsejtaa mantsala peyai'mujchi laranudetsu.
Tsenmin titi famuñu bain juntsa vee vee deka' uukaade, tsenmee naa ñulla chachilla bain, naa animaala bain fikenuu tananudetsu, timi.
Tsenñu Dios naake mandangueñuba Noé kumuinchi juntsanguemi.

footnotes.text: 6.2 Diosa' nala titu, naamika ura' mikeetyuñuba, mantsalaya selusha chumulanaa tsandimu deeve; tsenmala vejanlaya dee rukulanaa Diosa' nala kuremu deeve.
